passages.text: Many years later, during the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah, the son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub, the son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth, the son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki, the son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest— this Ezra came up from Babylon. He was a scribe skilled in the Law of Moses, which the LORD, the God of Israel, had given. The king had granted Ezra all his requests, for the hand of the LORD his God was upon him.
passages.sermon:
Ezra lived during the reign of Artaxerxes, king of Persia.
Ezra was the son of Seraiah.
Seraiah was the son of Azariah.
Azariah was the son of Hilkiah.
Hilkiah was the son of Shallum.
Shallum was the son of Zadok.
Zadok was the son of Ahitub.
Ahitub was the son of Amariah.
Amariah was the son of Azariah.
Azariah was the son of Meraioth.
Meraioth was the son of Zerahiah.
Zerahiah was the son of Uzzi.
Uzzi was the son of Bukki.
Bukki was the son of Abishua.
Abishua was the son of Phinehas.
Phinehas was the son of Eleazar.
Eleazar was the son of Aaron.
Aaron was the chief priest.
Ezra came up from Babylon.
Ezra was a scribe.
Ezra was skilled in the Law of Moses.
The LORD, the God of Israel, had given the Law of Moses.
The king gave Ezra everything he requested.
The hand of the LORD his God was upon Ezra.
passages.original: וְאַחַר֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה בְּמַלְכ֖וּת אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֣סְתְּא מֶֽלֶךְ־ פָּרָ֑ס עֶזְרָא֙ בֶּן־ שְׂרָיָ֔ה בֶּן־ עֲזַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ חִלְקִיָּֽה׃ בֶּן־ שַׁלּ֥וּם בֶּן־ צָד֖וֹק בֶּן־ אֲחִיטֽוּב׃ בֶּן־ אֲמַרְיָ֥ה בֶן־ עֲזַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ מְרָיֽוֹת׃ בֶּן־ זְרַֽחְיָ֥ה בֶן־ עֻזִּ֖י בֶּן־ בֻּקִּֽי׃ בֶּן־ אֲבִישׁ֗וּעַ בֶּן־ פִּֽינְחָס֙ בֶּן־ אֶלְעָזָ֔ר בֶּן־ אַהֲרֹ֥ן הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הָרֹֽאשׁ׃ ה֤וּא עֶזְרָא֙ עָלָ֣ה מִבָּבֶ֔ל וְהֽוּא־ סֹפֵ֤ר מָהִיר֙ בְּתוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּתֶּן־ ל֣וֹ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ כְּיַד־ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהָיו֙ עָלָ֔יו כֹּ֖ל בַּקָּשָׁתֽוֹ׃פ

passages.text: So in the seventh year of King Artaxerxes, he went up to Jerusalem with some of the Israelites, including priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, and temple servants.
passages.sermon:
King Artaxerxes ruled Persia.
This was the seventh year of his reign.
Ezra was a skilled scribe in the Law of Moses.
Ezra left Babylon and traveled to Jerusalem.
Some Israelites went with Ezra.
Priests went with him.
Levites went with him.
Singers went with him.
Gatekeepers went with him.
Temple servants went with him.
They all went up to Jerusalem together.
passages.original: וַיַּֽעֲל֣וּ מִבְּנֵֽי־ יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל וּמִן־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֜ם וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֧ים וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִ֛ים וְהַנְּתִינִ֖ים אֶל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם בִּשְׁנַת־ שֶׁ֖בַע לְאַרְתַּחְשַׁ֥סְתְּא הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: Ezra arrived in Jerusalem in the fifth month of the seventh year of the king.
passages.sermon:
Ezra was a priest and a skilled scribe in the Law of Moses.
Ezra left Babylon during the reign of King Artaxerxes of Persia.
Ezra arrived in Jerusalem.
He arrived in the fifth month.
This was the seventh year of King Artaxerxes.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁ֑י הִ֛יא שְׁנַ֥ת הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖ית לַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: He had begun the journey from Babylon on the first day of the first month, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month, for the gracious hand of his God was upon him.
passages.sermon:
Ezra was a priest and a scribe.
Ezra began his journey from Babylon.
He started on the first day of the first month.
Ezra arrived in Jerusalem.
He arrived on the first day of the fifth month.
God helped Ezra.
God’s gracious hand was upon him.
passages.original: כִּ֗י בְּאֶחָד֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן ה֣וּא יְסֻ֔ד הַֽמַּעֲלָ֖ה מִבָּבֶ֑ל וּבְאֶחָ֞ד לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁ֗י בָּ֚א אֶל־ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם כְּיַד־ אֱלֹהָ֖יו הַטּוֹבָ֥ה עָלָֽיו׃

passages.text: For Ezra had set his heart to study the Law of the LORD, to practice it, and to teach its statutes and ordinances in Israel.
passages.sermon:
Ezra was a priest and a scribe.
Ezra set his heart to seek the Law of the LORD.
Ezra studied the Law of the LORD.
Ezra practiced the Law of the LORD.
Ezra taught the statutes of the Law in Israel.
Ezra taught the ordinances of the Law in Israel.
passages.original: כִּ֤י עֶזְרָא֙ הֵכִ֣ין לְבָב֔וֹ לִדְר֛וֹשׁ אֶת־ תּוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה וְלַעֲשֹׂ֑ת וּלְלַמֵּ֥ד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חֹ֥ק וּמִשְׁפָּֽט׃ס

passages.text: This is the text of the letter King Artaxerxes had given to Ezra the priest and scribe, an expert in the commandments and statutes of the LORD to Israel: Artaxerxes, king of kings. To Ezra the priest, the scribe of the Law of the God of heaven: Greetings.
passages.sermon:
King Artaxerxes wrote a letter.
He gave this letter to Ezra.
Ezra was a priest.
Ezra was also a scribe.
Ezra was an expert in the commandments and statutes of the LORD for Israel.
The letter began with a greeting.
Artaxerxes called himself king of kings.
He addressed Ezra as priest and scribe of the Law of the God of heaven.
He sent greetings to Ezra.
passages.original: וְזֶ֣ה׀ פַּרְשֶׁ֣גֶן הַֽנִּשְׁתְּוָ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָתַן֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֔סְתְּא לְעֶזְרָ֥א הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַסֹּפֵ֑ר סֹפֵ֞ר דִּבְרֵ֧י מִצְוֺת־ יְהוָ֛ה וְחֻקָּ֖יו עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ אַ֨רְתַּחְשַׁ֔סְתְּא מֶ֖לֶךְ מַלְכַיָּ֑א לְעֶזְרָ֣א כָ֠הֲנָא סָפַ֨ר דָּתָ֜א דִּֽי־ אֱלָ֧הּ שְׁמַיָּ֛א גְּמִ֖יר וּכְעֶֽנֶת׃

passages.text: I hereby decree that any volunteers among the Israelites in my kingdom, including the priests and Levites, may go up with you to Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
King Artaxerxes ruled a vast kingdom.
He made a decree.
He spoke to Ezra.
He said, “Any Israelite in my kingdom may volunteer to go to Jerusalem with you.”
This includes the priests.
This includes the Levites.
All who wish to go may join you.
You may lead them to Jerusalem.
passages.original: מִנִּי֮ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵם֒ דִּ֣י כָל־ מִתְנַדַּ֣ב בְּמַלְכוּתִי֩ מִן־ עַמָּ֨ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וְכָהֲנ֣וֹהִי וְלֵוָיֵ֗א לִמְהָ֧ךְ לִֽירוּשְׁלֶ֛ם עִמָּ֖ךְ יְהָֽךְ׃

passages.text: You are sent by the king and his seven counselors to evaluate Judah and Jerusalem according to the Law of your God, which is in your hand.
passages.sermon:
King Artaxerxes ruled a vast kingdom.
He had seven counselors who advised him.
King Artaxerxes wrote a letter to Ezra.
Ezra was a priest and a scribe.
Ezra was an expert in the Law of God.
The king and his seven counselors sent Ezra on a mission.
They sent Ezra to Judah and Jerusalem.
Ezra was to evaluate Judah and Jerusalem.
Ezra was to use the Law of his God as his guide.
Ezra had the Law of God in his hand.
passages.original: כָּל־ קֳבֵ֗ל דִּי֩ מִן־ קֳדָ֨ם מַלְכָּ֜א וְשִׁבְעַ֤ת יָעֲטֹ֙הִי֙ שְׁלִ֔יחַ לְבַקָּרָ֥א עַל־ יְה֖וּד וְלִֽירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם בְּדָ֥ת אֱלָהָ֖ךְ דִּ֥י בִידָֽךְ׃

passages.text: Moreover, you are to take with you the silver and gold that the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose dwelling is in Jerusalem, together with all the silver and gold you may find in all the province of Babylon, as well as the freewill offerings of the people and priests to the house of their God in Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
The king of Persia and his counselors have given silver and gold.
They have given these gifts freely.
They have given them to the God of Israel.
The God of Israel lives in Jerusalem.
You must take this silver and gold with you.
You must also take all the silver and gold you find in the province of Babylon.
The people and the priests in Babylon have given freewill offerings.
These offerings are for the house of their God in Jerusalem.
You must take all these gifts to Jerusalem.
passages.original: וּלְהֵיבָלָ֖ה כְּסַ֣ף וּדְהַ֑ב דִּֽי־ מַלְכָּ֣א וְיָעֲט֗וֹהִי הִתְנַדַּ֙בוּ֙ לֶאֱלָ֣הּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל דִּ֥י בִֽירוּשְׁלֶ֖ם מִשְׁכְּנֵֽהּ׃ וְכֹל֙ כְּסַ֣ף וּדְהַ֔ב דִּ֣י תְהַשְׁכַּ֔ח בְּכֹ֖ל מְדִינַ֣ת בָּבֶ֑ל עִם֩ הִתְנַדָּב֨וּת עַמָּ֤א וְכָֽהֲנַיָּא֙ מִֽתְנַדְּבִ֔ין לְבֵ֥ית אֱלָהֲהֹ֖ם דִּ֥י בִירוּשְׁלֶֽם׃

passages.text: With this money, therefore, you are to buy as many bulls, rams, and lambs as needed, together with their grain offerings and drink offerings, and offer them on the altar at the house of your God in Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
You have money from the king and his counselors.
You must use this money to buy animals for sacrifice.
Buy bulls.
Buy rams.
Buy lambs.
Buy as many as you need.
Also buy grain offerings.
Also buy drink offerings.
Offer these animals and offerings on the altar.
The altar is in the house of your God.
The house of your God is in Jerusalem.
passages.original: כָּל־ קֳבֵ֣ל דְּנָה֩ אָסְפַּ֨רְנָא תִקְנֵ֜א בְּכַסְפָּ֣א דְנָ֗ה תּוֹרִ֤ין׀ דִּכְרִין֙ אִמְּרִ֔ין וּמִנְחָתְה֖וֹן וְנִסְכֵּיה֑וֹן וּתְקָרֵ֣ב הִמּ֔וֹ עַֽל־ מַדְבְּחָ֔ה דִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית אֱלָהֲכֹ֖ם דִּ֥י בִירוּשְׁלֶֽם׃

passages.text: You and your brothers may do whatever seems best with the rest of the silver and gold, according to the will of your God.
passages.sermon:
Ezra was a priest and a scribe of the Law of the God of heaven.
Ezra had brothers with him.
Ezra and his brothers received silver and gold.
They did not use all the silver and gold for offerings.
Ezra and his brothers had some silver and gold left.
Ezra and his brothers could decide what to do with the rest.
They could do whatever seemed best to them.
They must act according to the will of their God.
passages.original: וּמָ֣ה דִי֩ עֲלַיִךְ וְעַל־ אֶחַיִךְ יֵיטַ֗ב בִּשְׁאָ֛ר כַּסְפָּ֥א וְדַהֲבָ֖ה לְמֶעְבַּ֑ד כִּרְע֥וּת אֱלָהֲכֹ֖ם תַּעַבְדֽוּן׃

passages.text: You must deliver to the God of Jerusalem all the articles given to you for the service of the house of your God.
passages.sermon:
Ezra is a priest and a scribe.
He serves the God of heaven.
He is in Jerusalem.
People have given you articles for the service of the house of your God.
You must take all these articles.
You must deliver them.
You must bring them before the God of Jerusalem.
passages.original: וּמָֽאנַיָּא֙ דִּֽי־ מִתְיַהֲבִ֣ין לָ֔ךְ לְפָלְחָ֖ן בֵּ֣ית אֱלָהָ֑ךְ הַשְׁלֵ֕ם קֳדָ֖ם אֱלָ֥הּ יְרוּשְׁלֶֽם׃

passages.text: And if anything else is needed for the house of your God that you may have occasion to supply, you may pay for it from the royal treasury.
passages.sermon:
King Artaxerxes gave a command.
He spoke to Ezra and his companions.
He said, “If you need anything else for the house of your God, you may supply it.”
You may pay for these needs from the royal treasury.
The royal treasury belongs to the king.
passages.original: וּשְׁאָ֗ר חַשְׁחוּת֙ בֵּ֣ית אֱלָהָ֔ךְ דִּ֥י יִפֶּל־ לָ֖ךְ לְמִנְתַּ֑ן תִּנְתֵּ֕ן מִן־ בֵּ֖ית גִּנְזֵ֥י מַלְכָּֽא׃

passages.text: I, King Artaxerxes, decree to all the treasurers west of the Euphrates: Whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the Law of the God of heaven, may require of you, it must be provided promptly, up to a hundred talents of silver, a hundred cors of wheat, a hundred baths of wine, a hundred baths of olive oil, and salt without limit.
passages.sermon:
King Artaxerxes speaks.
He is the ruler.
He gives a command.
He addresses all treasurers west of the Euphrates River.
Ezra is a priest.
Ezra is a scribe.
Ezra knows the Law of the God of heaven.
If Ezra asks you for anything, you must give it to him quickly.
You must provide up to one hundred talents of silver.
You must provide up to one hundred cors of wheat.
You must provide up to one hundred baths of wine.
You must provide up to one hundred baths of olive oil.
You must provide salt without any limit.
passages.original: וּ֠מִנִּי אֲנָ֞ה אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֤סְתְּא מַלְכָּא֙ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵ֔ם לְכֹל֙ גִּזַּֽבְרַיָּ֔א דִּ֖י בַּעֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֑ה דִּ֣י כָל־ דִּ֣י יִ֠שְׁאֲלֶנְכוֹן עֶזְרָ֨א כָהֲנָ֜ה סָפַ֤ר דָּתָא֙ דִּֽי־ אֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֔א אָסְפַּ֖רְנָא יִתְעֲבִֽד׃ עַד־ כְּסַף֮ כַּכְּרִ֣ין מְאָה֒ וְעַד־ חִנְטִין֙ כֹּרִ֣ין מְאָ֔ה וְעַד־ חֲמַר֙ בַּתִּ֣ין מְאָ֔ה וְעַד־ בַּתִּ֥ין מְשַׁ֖ח מְאָ֑ה וּמְלַ֖ח דִּי־ לָ֥א כְתָֽב׃

passages.text: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven must be done diligently for His house. For why should wrath fall on the realm of the king and his sons?
passages.sermon:
The God of heaven gives commands.
People must do everything He commands.
They must do these things carefully.
They must do them for the house of the God of heaven.
If they do not obey, there may be wrath.
This wrath could come on the kingdom of the king.
This wrath could also come on the king’s sons.
passages.original: כָּל־ דִּ֗י מִן־ טַ֙עַם֙ אֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֔א יִתְעֲבֵד֙ אַדְרַזְדָּ֔א לְבֵ֖ית אֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֑א דִּֽי־ לְמָ֤ה לֶֽהֱוֵא֙ קְצַ֔ף עַל־ מַלְכ֥וּת מַלְכָּ֖א וּבְנֽוֹהִי׃

passages.text: And be advised that you have no authority to impose tribute, duty, or toll on any of the priests, Levites, singers, doorkeepers, temple servants, or other servants of this house of God.
passages.sermon:
King Artaxerxes gave a command.
He spoke to the officials west of the Euphrates River.
He said this command clearly.
You must not impose taxes on certain people.
You must not require tribute from them.
You must not collect tolls from them.
These people include all the priests.
They include all the Levites.
They include all the singers.
They include all the doorkeepers.
They include all the temple servants.
They include all other servants of the house of God.
You have no authority to make them pay tribute, duty, or toll.
passages.original: וּלְכֹ֣ם מְהוֹדְעִ֗ין דִּ֣י כָל־ כָּהֲנַיָּ֣א וְ֠לֵוָיֵא זַמָּ֨רַיָּ֤א תָרָֽעַיָּא֙ נְתִ֣ינַיָּ֔א וּפָ֣לְחֵ֔י בֵּ֖ית אֱלָהָ֣א דְנָ֑ה מִנְדָּ֤ה בְלוֹ֙ וַהֲלָ֔ךְ לָ֥א שַׁלִּ֖יט לְמִרְמֵ֥א עֲלֵיהֹֽם׃

passages.text: And you, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God which you possess, are to appoint magistrates and judges to judge all the people west of the Euphrates—all who know the laws of your God. And you are to teach these laws to anyone who does not know them.
passages.sermon:
Ezra was a priest and a scribe.
Ezra possessed the wisdom of God.
Ezra received authority from the king.
Ezra must appoint magistrates and judges.
These magistrates and judges must serve all the people west of the Euphrates River.
They must judge everyone who knows the laws of God.
Ezra must also teach the laws of God.
He must teach these laws to anyone who does not know them.
passages.original: וְאַ֣נְתְּ עֶזְרָ֗א כְּחָכְמַ֨ת אֱלָהָ֤ךְ דִּֽי־ בִידָךְ֙ מֶ֣נִּי שָׁפְטִ֞ין וְדַיָּנִ֗ין דִּי־ לֶהֱוֺ֤ן דָּאֲנִין לְכָל־ עַמָּה֙ דִּ֚י בַּעֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֔ה לְכָל־ יָדְעֵ֖י דָּתֵ֣י אֱלָהָ֑ךְ וְדִ֧י לָ֦א יָדַ֖ע תְּהוֹדְעֽוּן׃

passages.text: If anyone does not keep the law of your God and the law of the king, let a strict judgment be executed against him, whether death, banishment, confiscation of property, or imprisonment.
passages.sermon:
Anyone who does not obey the law of your God must face judgment.
Anyone who does not obey the law of the king must also face judgment.
The court must carry out this judgment strictly.
The punishment may be death.
The punishment may be banishment.
The punishment may be the taking away of property.
The punishment may be imprisonment.
passages.original: וְכָל־ דִּי־ לָא֩ לֶהֱוֵ֨א עָבֵ֜ד דָּתָ֣א דִֽי־ אֱלָהָ֗ךְ וְדָתָא֙ דִּ֣י מַלְכָּ֔א אָסְפַּ֕רְנָא דִּינָ֕ה לֶהֱוֵ֥א מִתְעֲבֵ֖ד מִנֵּ֑הּ הֵ֤ן לְמוֹת֙ הֵ֣ן לִשְׁרֹשׁוּ הֵן־ לַעֲנָ֥שׁ נִכְסִ֖ין וְלֶאֱסוּרִֽין׃פ

passages.text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of our fathers, who has put into the heart of the king to so honor the house of the LORD in Jerusalem, and who has shown me favor before the king, his counselors, and all his powerful officials. And because the hand of the LORD my God was upon me, I took courage and gathered the leaders of Israel to return with me.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of our fathers.
The LORD put this desire into the king’s heart.
The king wanted to honor the house of the LORD in Jerusalem.
The LORD showed me favor before the king.
The LORD showed me favor before the king’s counselors.
The LORD showed me favor before all the king’s powerful officials.
The hand of the LORD my God was upon me.
I became strong.
I gathered the leaders of Israel.
The leaders of Israel returned with me.
passages.original: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתֵ֑ינוּ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן כָּזֹאת֙ בְּלֵ֣ב הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לְפָאֵ֕ר אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ וְעָלַ֣י הִטָּה־ חֶ֗סֶד לִפְנֵ֤י הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וְיֽוֹעֲצָ֔יו וּלְכָל־ שָׂרֵ֥י הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ הַגִּבֹּרִ֑ים וַאֲנִ֣י הִתְחַזַּ֗קְתִּי כְּיַד־ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהַי֙ עָלַ֔י וָאֶקְבְּצָ֧ה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֛ל רָאשִׁ֖ים לַעֲל֥וֹת עִמִּֽי׃פ
